settings.title: Mipangilio
settings.generalDescription: Lugha na mwonekano wa dashibodi hii.
settings.advancedDescription: Vizingiti na swichi za usalama za mfumo wa ubanaji.
settings.compressionDescription: Punguza ukubwa wa ombi kabla ya uelekezaji huku ukihifadhi msimbo, hitilafu, njia, nambari, na ufafanuzi wa zana.
settings.compressionHelp: Huandika upya kila ombi kabla halijatumwa kwa mtoa huduma ili litumie tokeni chache. Msimbo, hitilafu, njia za faili na nambari hulindwa, na uandishi wowote upya unaoziharibu hutupwa.
settings.compressionModeHelp: Imezimwa hutuma maombi bila kuyagusa. Bila hasara huondoa tu maandishi yaliyojirudia na yasiyo na maana. Kawaida pia hufupisha matokeo ya zana. Kali huongeza kufupisha zamu za zamani.
settings.compressionEnginesHelp: Kila injini ni hatua moja ya kuandika upya. Hali huamua injini zipi zifanye kazi; kuzima moja hapa huiondoa katika kila hali.
settings.engineDedupHelp: Hubadilisha kipande cha maandishi kilichotokea awali kwenye mazungumzo kwa marejeleo mafupi.
settings.engineLiteHelp: Hukata nafasi za mwisho, huunganisha mistari mitupu inayojirudia na huondoa ujumbe wa mfumo uliojirudia.
settings.engineReadLifecycleHelp: Hubadilisha usomaji wa faili wa awali kwa dokezo mara faili hiyo hiyo inaposomwa au kuhaririwa tena baadaye.
settings.engineToolfilterHelp: Hufupisha matokeo ya amri na zana kama vile ujenzi, majaribio na usakinishaji. Mistari ya hitilafu na ya stack-trace hubaki daima.
settings.engineJsoncompactHelp: Husimba upya safu ndefu za JSON zenye sehemu zinazofanana kama jedwali fupi. Inaweza kurudishwa, hivyo hakuna kinachopotea.
settings.engineRelevanceHelp: Huondoa sentensi zisizohusiana sana na ujumbe wa hivi karibuni pale ujumbe unapozidi kikomo chake cha ukubwa.
settings.engineAgingHelp: Hufupisha zamu zilizopita zaidi ya chache za hivi karibuni kuwa muhtasari mfupi unaohifadhi njia, hitilafu na maamuzi.
settings.engineHardBudgetHelp: Huondoa mistari yenye thamani ndogo hadi ombi litoshee lengo la tokeni.
settings.compressionAutoTrigger: Anzisha kiotomatiki juu ya tokeni zilizokadiriwa
settings.compressionAutoTriggerHelp: Maombi yanayokadiriwa kuzidi idadi hii ya tokeni hubadilika kuwa Kali kiotomatiki. Acha wazi ili kuzima.
settings.compressionPrefixFreezeHelp: Huacha agizo la mfumo bila kuguswa mara maandishi yale yale yanapoonekana mara tatu, ili uhifadhi wa maagizo upande wa mtoa huduma uendelee kufanya kazi.
settings.compressionTrustProjectFilters: Amini faili za kichujio za mradi
settings.compressionTrustProjectFiltersHelp: Hupakia pia vichujio vya matokeo ya zana kutoka saraka ya kazi. Imezimwa kwa chaguo-msingi, kwa sababu hazina inaweza kuitumia kuficha matokeo kwa modeli.
settings.compressionPreviewDescription: Pitisha mwili wa ombi kwenye mfumo ili uone kile ambacho mtoa huduma angepokea.
settings.compressionPreviewPlaceholder: Bandika JSON ya ombi au maandishi wazi
settings.buildAhead: Toleo hili liko mbele ya tawi rasmi la main.
settings.buildDiverged: Toleo hili limejitenga na tawi rasmi la main.
settings.buildUnknown: Toleo hili maalum haliwezi kulinganishwa na tawi rasmi la main.
settings.notGitInstall: Usakinishaji huu hauna taarifa za commit.
settings.restartAfterUpdate: Anzisha upya FreeLLMAPI baada ya ujenzi kukamilika.
settings.updateReadyHint: Imepakuliwa. FreeLLMAPI huhifadhi nakala ya data yako, huanza upya na kufungua toleo jipya.
settings.updatingContainer: Inavuta picha mpya na kuanza upya. Ukurasa huu utapakia upya FreeLLMAPI itakaporudi.
settings.updateNowFailed: Kisasishaji hakikukubali ombi. Hakikisha kontena la watchtower linafanya kazi.
settings.updateNowTimeout: FreeLLMAPI haijaanza upya baada ya dakika 5. Angalia kumbukumbu za kontena la watchtower.
settings.contactsGithub: Checks are manual and contact GitHub.
settings.autoUpdateCheckHelp: Checks GitHub once a day for a new release and shows a reminder. Off by default.

Mifano isiyo na kiwango kinachotambulika hupata alama ya chini kabisa kwenye mhimili huu, lakini akili ni mmoja tu kati ya mihimili mitatu — kuegemea na kasi nzuri bado vinaweza kuipatia njia.

models.providerRoutingDescription: Automatic uses live routing scores. Preferred order tries your list first while retaining health, quota, cooldown and failover protections.
models.capacityEstimateHint: Catalogue estimates for enabled routes with usable, in-scope keys. Shared allowances count once. Daily quotas renew and unknown allowances are excluded, so this is not a live remaining balance.

strategies.exploreHint: Give models with no reliability or speed data a 10% chance to go first so they build a track record. Your real request is what gets sent, so it may be answered by an untested model. For a custom endpoint, use Probe endpoint on the Keys page to test it without live traffic.
strategies.keySelectionHint: Jinsi ya kuchagua kati ya funguo kadhaa za mtoa huduma mmoja. Otomatiki huhifadhi mzunguko wa sasa; Iliyobaki kidogo zaidi hupanga funguo kwa kiasi kilichoonekana na hujaribu kwanza ile yenye kiasi kikubwa zaidi kilichobaki.
strategies.cooldownCeiling: Kipindi kirefu zaidi cha kupoa kiotomatiki
strategies.cooldownCeilingHint: Huweka kikomo cha muda ambao makisio ya kipanga njia chenyewe yanaweza kuweka kando jozi ya ufunguo na modeli inayoshindwa. Ngazi kwa kawaida hupanda dakika 2, dakika 10, saa 1, saa 24, na makosa ya salio au daraja huweka kando kwa siku moja. Muda wa kujaribu tena uliotajwa na mtoa huduma haufupishwi kamwe.
strategies.peakActiveHint: Marekebisho ya saa za msongamano yanatumika sasa hivi, hivyo hizi si uzito wa kiolezo chenyewe: asilimia 60 ya uzito wa kasi umehamishiwa kwenye uaminifu.
strategies.peakAdjustHint: Imezimwa kwa chaguo-msingi. Ndani ya kipindi kilicho hapa chini, huhamisha asilimia 60 ya uzito wa kasi kwenda kwenye uaminifu — relei za bure hujaa zaidi wakati huo, hivyo uaminifu hutabiri mafanikio vizuri kuliko kasi pekee. «Ya kasi zaidi» na «Inayoaminika zaidi» hazibadilishwi.
strategies.peakUseBrowserTimezone: Tumia saa za eneo za kivinjari
strategies.peakExemptNote: Kiolezo hiki hakibadilishwi — tayari kiko upande mmoja wa uwiano wa kasi na uaminifu.
strategies.title: Mkakati wa uelekezaji
strategies.description: Chagua mkakati wa uelekezaji. Katika hali ya Mwongozo, buruta ili kuweka mpangilio; mikakati mingine kupitia matokeo ya moja kwa moja katika kuegemea, kasi na akili.
strategies.guardrailsTooltip: Misingi ya ulinzi inayowekwa kila wakati: chumba cha kichwa bila malipo × adhabu ya kikomo cha moja kwa moja. Chini ya 1.0 inamaanisha kuwa mtindo unazuiliwa.
strategies.scoreTooltip: Alama ya mwisho ya uelekezaji = wastani wa uzani wa shoka tatu, ikizidishwa na safu za ulinzi. Njia za juu kwanza.
strategies.modeManualHint: Hali ya Mwongozo: maombi hufuata mpangilio ulio hapa chini, kutoka juu hadi chini. Buruta ili kupanga upya.
strategies.modeScoreHint: Sasisho la alama kutoka kwa trafiki ya moja kwa moja. Agizo lililo hapa chini ni jinsi maombi yanavyoelekezwa sasa hivi.
strategies.manualBlurb: Njia kwa mpangilio kamili ulioweka hapa chini. Buruta vishikizo ili kupanga upya. Hakuna bao; mlolongo unafuatwa kutoka juu hadi chini.
strategies.balancedBlurb: Kuegemea inaongoza (50%), kwa kasi na akili uzito sawa (25% kila moja). Chaguo-msingi la busara la pande zote.
strategies.smartestBlurb: Pendelea muundo wa uwezo zaidi ambao bado unafanya kazi. Akili 55%, kuegemea 35%, kasi 10%.
strategies.fastestBlurb: Pendelea muundo wa haraka zaidi ambao bado unafanya kazi. Kasi 55%, kuegemea 35%, akili 10%.
strategies.reliableBlurb: Ongeza kiwango cha mafanikio zaidi ya yote. Kuegemea 70%, kasi na akili 15% kila moja.
strategies.customBlurb: Weka usawa wako mwenyewe wa kuegemea, kasi na akili na vitelezi. Injini sawa na usanidi, uzani wako tu.
strategies.customWeightsHelp: Slider ni huru; inashiriki salio otomatiki hadi 100%.
strategies.weightRequired: Angalau uzito mmoja lazima uwe juu ya sifuri.
strategies.minReliabilityFloorHint: Drop a model from routing once its observed success rate falls below this. 0.8 means 80%. Leave blank to disable — models with too little history are always kept so new models can still be tried. Never empties the whole chain.
strategies.providerMomentAttribution: Attribute rate-limit failures to the provider
strategies.providerMomentAttributionHint: When on, 429s, 5xx errors, timeouts and dropped connections are treated as the provider having a bad minute: they still bench the key, but they no longer count against the model's reliability score. Off by default — leave it off to keep today's scoring.
strategies.decisionBlurb: A decision model reads each request and picks Smartest, Fastest, Balanced or Most reliable for it. When it is unsure, slow or unavailable, the request routes as Balanced. Needs a Cloudflare or OpenRouter key.
strategies.decisionSettingsHelp: For each request, a decision model picks the strategy that fits it best. Requests that pin a model are never asked about.
strategies.decisionNotReady: No decision model is ready, so every request routes as Balanced. Add a Cloudflare or OpenRouter key and turn on a model under Models → Decision.
strategies.decisionMinConfidenceHelp: Below this, the request routes as Balanced.
strategies.decisionFallbacks: {count} routed as Balanced (unsure, slow or unavailable)
strategies.decisionSetupTitle: Add a free key to use Decision
strategies.decisionSetupHelp: Decision routing asks a free decision model which strategy fits each request. It needs a key for one of these providers. Both have a free tier, no card needed.
strategies.decisionNoModels: No decision model is turned on yet. Turn one on under Models → Decision.

keys.keyProxyRemoved: The proxy is removed when you save, and this key goes back to the global proxy.
keys.groupLabelHint: Optional: endpoints in the same group are listed together, and a request can stay inside the group with custom:<model>#<group>. Leave blank for the default Custom group.

keys.liveModelsFallback: No curated rows are available for this provider, so these models come from its live API.
keys.providerAccountLimitsHint: Blank inherits the provider default. Zero disables that account-wide gate.
keys.panelProbedHint: Routable models whose limits have been measured from the provider, rather than taken from the catalogue.
keys.healthDeadHint: This route refused in a way waiting will not fix — blocked, not found, or failing every attempt. Enabling it spends a failover attempt on nothing.
keys.healthLimitedHint: The route works; its allowance is spent right now.
keys.healthOkHint: This route answered a real request. The time beside it is when.
keys.healthCode_E403: blocked for this account — enable it with the provider, or drop the route
keys.healthCode_E404: the provider does not know this model id
keys.healthCode_E401: credential rejected — about the key, not the model
keys.healthCode_ETIME: we stopped waiting — says nothing about the model
keys.healthCode_EOTHER: refused for another reason — hover the badge
keys.panelAllFiltered: All {count} models on this provider are hidden — none can route right now.
keys.panelResetHint: When this provider's allowance next returns. The soonest of its quota windows, including one folded behind a shorter window on the Quota page.
keys.scopeEmptyNoModels: This provider has no catalogue models.
keys.scopeEmptyCatalogueOff: This provider has {count} models in the catalogue, all switched off there. Re-enable them on the Models page to scope this key.
keys.panelWhyKeyOff: key unusable - switched off or failing
keys.panelHideNothing: Every model here can serve a request - nothing to hide
keys.bonusEmpty: No bonus grants configured. Create one to add temporary capacity on top of normal allowances.
keys.bonusNormalFirstHint: The normal daily allowance is used first, every day. Only usage beyond it draws on the pool, and only while a spending window is open. Request and token grants only: credit and money grants need per-request cost metering, which this install does not have.
keys.bonusAllowancePlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current window
keys.bonusWindowHint: Opening a window closes the current one. It draws on what the pool has left and never refills it.
keys.bonusNoActiveAllowance: No open spending window: requests stop at the normal allowance
keys.paidCreditHint: Selected paid models are tried only after every free route, and only while a credit window on the key has room. Spend is the rise in the provider's own reported usage, not an estimate. One paid request runs at a time so each is measured before the next. Usage by other clients of the account counts too.
keys.paidCreditGuardOff: The paid-balance guard is off: paid models already route without any window, and windows are not consulted.
keys.paidCreditEmpty: No key on a provider that reports its credit balance (OpenRouter).

keys.paidCreditNoBalance: No credit balance read for this key yet, so no window can open.

keys.paidCreditAwaiting: waiting for the balance to measure the last request
keys.quotaDashHint: One card per provider you hold an enabled key for. Bars show what is left: green above half, amber below half, red at 20% or less. A spent allowance fades until it resets.
keys.quotaDashNoReading: No allowance reported by this provider.

keys.quotaRawHidden: {count} readings for deleted or disabled keys hidden

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Save the routing data to a .sql file beside the database, and restore it later.
backups.excludedNote: A backup carries your providers, models, routing settings and request history. Accounts, sessions and URL tokens are never included, so a dump holds no password hashes or login tokens and restoring one cannot log you out. Provider keys stay encrypted with this server's ENCRYPTION_KEY: a backup can only be restored on a server that still holds that key.
backups.selectHint: Back up everything, or pick the tables you need.
backups.restored: Restored. The previous data was saved as {filename}.
backups.autoHint: The server writes a full backup on this cadence.
backups.pathHint: Relative to the database directory. Backups cannot be written outside it.

offload.title: Offloaded inference
offload.valueHint: Value = what the same tokens cost on the equivalent paid model. Not subscription money saved.

analytics.routingRejectionHint: Requests FreeLLM refused without trying a provider: no configured route for the model, or every route in the chain cooling, blocked or out of quota. The error column names each candidate and why it was skipped.

premium.title: Premium
premium.description: Katalogi ya muundo wa moja kwa moja, kwenye kila kifaa.

premium.snapshotDescription: Kiwango cha bure: katalogi huonyeshwa upya kutoka kwa muhtasari wa kila mwezi, iliyoangaliwa kiotomatiki mara mbili kwa siku. Premium hubadilisha hii hadi mipasho ya moja kwa moja, inayosasishwa kila baada ya siku 2-3.

premium.keyHint: Ufunguo wako upo kwenye barua pepe yako ya ununuzi na kwenye ukurasa wa baada ya kulipa. Umeipoteza?

agents.description: Unganisha zana za usimbaji na lango moja la miundo ya bure kwa usanidi ulioundwa na ulio salama kwa hifadhi rudufu.
agents.quickstart: Njia ya haraka zaidi: sanidi Claude Code kutoka kwenye katalogi ya moja kwa moja.

descriptions.claude: Anthropic's terminal agent: it plans, edits files, and runs commands in your repo.
descriptions.codex: OpenAI's terminal agent, which runs your task in a local sandbox first.
descriptions.cline: A VS Code extension that asks you to approve every edit and command.
descriptions.continue: A VS Code and JetBrains extension for inline autocomplete and chat while you type.
descriptions.aider: A command-line pair programmer that turns each change into its own git commit.
descriptions.opencode: A provider-agnostic terminal agent with a full-screen text interface.
descriptions.goose: Block's local agent, extended with MCP servers to reach past your code.
descriptions.qwen: A Gemini CLI fork tuned for Qwen models and large repositories.
descriptions.roo: A VS Code extension with switchable modes: architect, coder, debugger.
descriptions.kilo: A VS Code extension merging Roo and Cline, with an orchestrator that splits up work.
descriptions.crush: Charm's terminal agent, written in Go, with one session per project.
descriptions.dsh: DeepSeek's harness, which keeps every provider as a route you can switch between.
descriptions.mimo: Xiaomi's terminal agent, an OpenCode fork that takes any OpenAI-compatible provider.
descriptions.cursor: The AI-first editor; it calls through Cursor's cloud, so it needs a public URL.
descriptions.generic: Anything else that speaks the OpenAI API, set up by hand from a base URL and key.
descriptions.atomcode: AtomGit's terminal agent, written in Rust, that takes any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
descriptions.openclaw: Msaidizi binafsi anayefanya kazi muda wote na kujibu kwenye WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord na zaidi kutoka kwenye mashine yako mwenyewe.
descriptions.hermes: Wakala wa Nous Research anayejiboresha mwenyewe, mwenye kumbukumbu ya kudumu na ujuzi, kwenye terminal au kwenye programu za gumzo.
descriptions.pi: Wakala mdogo wa terminal unaomuunda kwa viendelezi, ujuzi na violezo vya maagizo vyako mwenyewe.
descriptions.reasonix: Wakala wa kuandika msimbo kwenye terminal aliyejengwa kwa ajili ya DeepSeek, kwa msingi wa prefix caching ili vipindi virefu vibaki nafuu.
descriptions.zcode: Z.ai's coding agent for its GLM models, speaking any OpenAI-compatible endpoint through a provider registry.

compare.costBasisTask: USD Artificial Analysis measured to run one task of its Intelligence Index, cheapest first. Covers only the models AA has run it on.

fleet.title: Free CLI fleet
fleet.description: What each machine can reach on the free CLI rosters, and what it has spent. Machines report their own state; FreeLLM stores what it is told.
fleet.notRoutable: Observation only — these routes cannot be called from FreeLLM. Their free tiers refuse callers outside the vendor's own CLI, so they never appear in routing or model pickers.
fleet.proxyScoreHint: This score is an estimate for a related variant, not a measurement of this route.
fleet.staleWarning: This machine has not reported for {ago}. Its rows may no longer be true.
fleet.emptyHint: Run clifree-report.sh --post on a machine with the free CLIs installed.
fleet.legendFleet: reachable only from a free CLI agent, never from FreeLLM
fleet.legendBoth: A model showing both marks is reachable from either agent.
fleet.legendServed: Marks with no CLI fleet badge: FreeLLM can serve it too, and an agent can also reach it.
fleet.valueHint: Market value of the inference this machine was given: the published per-million rates of each route's benchmark equivalent, applied to the tokens it actually consumed. Not what we paid, which is nothing.
fleet.valueUnknownHint: No route this machine used maps to a benchmark that publishes a price, so the inference cannot be valued. Unpriced is not the same as worthless.

compare.scopeClifreeHint: Routes a free CLI agent can actually drive, as reported by your machines. Not a platform filter: a catalogue route no machine reports is excluded, and Cline's free models appear only in the fleet table below — FreeLLM cannot call them.
compare.resetHint: Back to defaults: intelligence chart, routed scope, no search, nothing pinned.
compare.chainNoRoutable: No models in this group have a usable key for this provider. Add a key or enable an existing one first.
compare.tokensPerTaskHint: How many tokens the model spends to finish one task. An AA range is derived from their published cost per task: all billed at the output price (fewest) to all at the input price (most). A screen figure is what our own benchmark measured.
compare.tokensPerTaskAaTooltip: ≈{tokens} tokens per AA task at a 3:1 input:output mix (the sort value)
compare.tokensPerTaskScreenTooltip: {tokens} tokens per task, measured by our screening benchmark ({scenarios} scenarios, bench v{version})
compare.noToolsRouteHint: This provider does not advertise tool calling on this route, so chains that need tools skip it. The agentic score describes the model, measured with tools.
compare.noToolsModelHint: None of this model's routes advertise tool calling, so chains that need tools skip it. The agentic score describes the model, measured with tools.
compare.staleSnapshot: Showing the snapshot from {lastSync}. The last refresh ({lastAttempt}) failed: {lastError}
compare.versionMismatch: Rankings use Intelligence Index {scoringVersion} (archived). Artificial Analysis now publishes {indexVersion}.
compare.retiredMetrics: Coding and Agentic are no longer published by Artificial Analysis; these are archived values.
compare.switchScoringConfirm: Scores on the two versions are not comparable. Chain minimums were set on {version} and are not converted; review them after switching.

catalogue.changesHint: Models added since {since}, and retirements not yet acknowledged.
catalogue.changesShowUnkeyed: Show {count} more on providers with no key
catalogue.changesAllReadHint: {count} changes in the last month, none unread.
catalogue.changesMarkReadHint: Marks every change on this panel as read. Nothing is deleted — Model history on the Premium page keeps the full record.
catalogue.syncsNamesMissing: Model names were not recorded for this update; only the counts are known.
catalogue.currentStatusHint: Filters use current local model enablement, not the feed's historical state. Models no longer installed are disabled. Counts cover recorded model details.
catalogue.noMatchingUpdates: No catalogue changes match these filters.
catalogue.syncsHint: One entry per day, counted against the catalog before it. Updates that changed nothing are not recorded, and several updates in one day merge into their net change.
catalogue.hiddenUnkeyed: {count} changes from providers without a key hidden
catalogue.syncsNotNetted: too large to net per model: counts are summed

quota.title: Quota
quota.emptyShadow: No shadow decisions recorded yet — these appear once traffic flows
quota.shadowCaveat: Shadow records which provider quota-aware scoring would have preferred. It cannot say that choice would have been better — the preferred provider never ran.
quota.agreementSummary: {agreed} of {total} decisions agreed with the live router.
quota.emptyDivergence: No disagreements recorded — the two routers have picked the same provider every time so far.
quota.locallyCountedHint: The provider never reported this pool; the count is ours, against a limit we hold.
quota.burnCaveat: Spends this provider’s free allowance until it refuses, to find out what the allowance is. The allowance does not come back until the provider’s own reset. Capped at 120 requests or 3 minutes per run; finds the tightest limit, then times the refusal to identify which one it was.
quota.derivedAllowanceHint: Derived from measured usage against the reported fraction: {low}–{high} across {samples} intervals
quota.policyEditorHint: Declare a limit and its reset for a provider that does not report one. Operator policies outrank documentation and catalogue figures, and are outranked by anything the provider measures.
quota.resetInferredHint: Predicted from observed reset boundaries — this provider sends no reset time. Accurate to within the polling interval.
quota.probesHint: What a provider’s limits were measured to be, and whether the catalogue agrees. Measuring spends real quota, so each run is kept.
quota.probeClaimedThen: The catalogue claimed {claimed} when this ran, and has since been corrected.
quota.windowKindHint: A rolling window frees one call at a time as the oldest ages out. A calendar window returns the whole allowance at midnight in the named zone.
quota.notInChain: enabled, but excluded by the active chain — spends nothing
quota.limitFromPoolHint: No limit of its own: this model spends the provider allowance shown on the pool row above.
quota.bucketNoResetHint: This allowance refills continuously rather than resetting: spend one and it returns after the interval shown, so there is no boundary to wait for.
quota.bindsFirstHint: One allowance, measured over more than one window. This is the window with the least headroom, so it is the one that will refuse the next request.
quota.poolSummedHint: This total is the sum of the models below, each of which holds its own allowance — not a ceiling the provider stated.

extensions.paidWarning: Turning this off lets automatic routing and fallback spend real credit on OpenRouter, AnyAPI and unorouter. This is not a spending limit — there is no cap behind it. Naming a paid model explicitly already works and is unaffected. Type {phrase} to authorise it.
extensions.title: Imperium extensions
extensions.intro: Features added by the separate Imperium FreeLLMAPI branch. Each switch turns one extension off without deleting anything it has stored; the links open the pages that own its real settings.
extensions.footer: Switching an extension off hides its surface and stops its behaviour. It never drops a table, a saved scope or a merge you have already made — see “When off” on each entry.

chainMinimums.title: Chain minimums
chainMinimums.recommendOnly: Recommendations only. Nothing here changes a chain or routing.
chainMinimums.membersHint: Enabled members in the order the router tries them: unlimited first, then chain priority. Health, cooldowns and quota can still skip one.
chainMinimums.eitherOffHint: Required: the model must meet this one. Click to make it one of the alternatives (OR).
chainMinimums.eitherOnHint: One of the alternatives: meeting any one OR score is enough. Click to make it required (AND).
chainMinimums.eitherRule: Needs {required}, plus at least one of {either}.

chainFit.appendHint: Adds selected routes at the end. Existing members, active chain, model switches and key scopes stay unchanged.
chainFit.saveFirst: Save threshold edits before applying recommendations.
chainFit.noAdditions: No eligible new members. Recommended routes are already in these chains, unavailable, or no longer meet the minimums.
chainFit.changedReview: Recommendations changed. Review the refreshed choices and confirm again.

capacity.title: AMD shared allocation and model capacity
capacity.unavailable: Capacity source unavailable. Any values shown are last reported, not current.
capacity.sharedHint: Every AMD model served by this key draws from the same free usage allocation. It is counted once per credential/pool. Usage points are not a paid cash balance.
capacity.rpmHint: This is the provider's short request-rate window, not the free allocation. A reading older than one minute is last reported, not current headroom.
capacity.fleetHint: Shared AMD backend load for this model, not your key's usage or a probability of success. A full model can coexist with an almost unused account allocation.

scoreProvenance.familyHelp: Borrowed from a related model in the same family.
scoreProvenance.superseded: Your {value} ({provenance}) was replaced by a measurement.
scoreProvenance.archivedTitle: Published by Artificial Analysis under {version} on {asOf}; no longer published.
scoreProvenance.derivedTitle: Estimated from {basis} = {basisValue} with a straight-line fit over {n} models that have both scores, on the {scale} scale. Typical miss ±{error}. Not counted toward a chain minimum unless that chain accepts estimates; type a score to replace it.
scoreProvenance.derivedExtrapolated: * This model is outside the range the fit was made on, so the miss can be larger.

chainArrange.title: Auto-arrange
chainArrange.description: Chains that re-order themselves from measured evidence. Preview a pass, pin a model, or run one now.
chainArrange.gatedHint: Arranging and probing are switched off in Extensions. Stored orders stay as last written; settings and history are kept.
chainArrange.toleranceHint: A model within this percentage below a chain's floor stays eligible as near-fit instead of falling out.
chainArrange.conflict: Auto-arrange settings changed elsewhere while you were editing. The latest version is loaded - review your changes and save again.
chainArrange.saveFailed: Could not save the auto-arrange settings.
chainArrange.minMembersHint: Models required above the failing tail before the chain counts as deep enough.
chainArrange.minPoolsHint: Independent quota pools required among the first min members.
chainArrange.previewHint: Compute what a pass would do now, without writing anything.
chainArrange.previewWouldMove: A pass would move {moved} routes. Nothing is written until you arrange.
chainArrange.previewNoChange: A pass would leave the order as it is.
chainArrange.arrangeNowHint: Run the arranger on this chain and write the order when it changed. Works even with auto off.
chainArrange.reliabilityHint: Successful of attempted calls over the reliability window (real traffic plus probes).
chainArrange.pinnedHint: Pinned to this position - the arranger keeps it here
chainArrange.runsHint: Every written arrangement, newest first. Open one to read the before-and-after with the reasons.
chainArrange.footer: An hourly pass rewrites chains with auto on from measured evidence. With arranging off, stored orders freeze as last written; settings, pins and history are kept.

routeHistory.title: Route history
routeHistory.avgLatency: Average latency of successful calls: {ms} ms
routeHistory.dailyEmpty: No real traffic or probes in the window
routeHistory.probesEmpty: No probes recorded for this route yet
